title: ImageElementProps
description: The props of an image element (epic Tale Studio R5): an image (GIF included) of the tale's project, by its storage key (AD-11), never a URL. Its alt text is the element's `a11y.label`; publishing needs it, or `a11y.decorative` (R12).

mediaKey.description: The storage key of an image of the tale's project, as the server made it.

fit.description: How the media fills its box: `cover` crops it to fill the box, `contain` shows all of it.

radius.description: The corner radius as a fraction of the canvas height; 0 when left out.

taleMedia.description: True on the tale's own media (epic Tale Studio R16): the element the server keeps in step with the tale's media, which a tale from before documents, a dashboard upload and an import create. While it is the bottom element with the full-canvas box, unrotated, unrounded and opaque, viewers draw it full-bleed behind the canvas, as tale media always was. A document holds at most one.
